## team

**Team 隊伍.** Core team management. Inspect teammates (AI agents), groups, drafts and capabilities, and create, edit or delete teammates and groups. Also manages tool allowlists, caps, variables, triggers, persona/schedule and budgets. Always set `tools` (least privilege) when creating a teammate.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `overview` | `read` |  | List all teammates, groups and drafts (do this first). |
| `get_room` | `read` |  | Get one group's details and member types. |
| `get_agent` | `read` |  | Get one teammate's details (prompt, caps, triggers). |
| `capabilities` | `read` |  | List the tools, MCP servers, skills and workflows that can be assigned, plus profiles. |
| `changes` | `read` |  | Show the change log. |
| `guide` | `read` |  | Show guide text (`flow`, `blueprint`, `triggers`, `vars`, `caps`, `harness`, `lint_codes`, `types`, `confirm`, or `<tool>.<action>`). |
| `create_agent` | `edit` | approval (some args) | Create a teammate (needs approval). Omitting `tools` or using "all" means unrestricted and needs spend plus confirmation. |
| `update_agent` | `edit` |  | Update a teammate's name, title, description, emoji, color, notify, prompt or archived flag. |
| `set_tools` | `edit` | approval (some args) | Replace a teammate's tool allowlist (needs approval; "all" means unrestricted). |
| `set_caps` | `edit` | approval (some args) | Set a teammate's full caps object `{tools, mcp, skills, workflows}` (needs approval). |
| `set_type` | `edit` | approval (some args) | Set a teammate as lead and/or assign a tool-bundle profile (needs approval). |
| `set_agent_vars` | `edit` |  | Set or unset a teammate's variables. |
| `set_room_vars` | `edit` |  | Set or unset a group's variables (prompts reference them as `{{key}}`). |
| `set_triggers` | `edit` |  | Replace a teammate's whole trigger rule set (call `get_agent` first; see `guide triggers`). |
| `set_persona` | `edit` | approval (some args) | Set social persona and/or auto-schedule, merged with existing; enabling a schedule needs spend (needs approval; see `guide persona`). |
| `set_budget` | `edit` | approval (some args) | Set a teammate's budget `{mode, cap_hwt, share_pct, period, on_exceed}`; raising or removing the cap needs spend (needs approval). |
| `budget_approve` | `spend` | paid, approval | Approve extra budget for a teammate (needs approval). |
| `create_room` | `edit` |  | Create a group. |
| `update_room` | `edit` |  | Update a group (name, goal, `reply_mode`, `lead_agent_id`, archived, `hive_private`) and add or remove members. |
| `delete_agent` | `edit` | approval | Delete a teammate; conversations are kept (needs approval). |
| `delete_room` | `edit` | approval | Delete a group (needs approval). |

## team_blueprint

**Team 藍圖精靈.** Generate a whole team from a brief, documents or a template. Use `draft` (AI asks, designs, checks) or `author` (you write the blueprint), then `review`, `patch_agent`/`revise`, and `apply`. Drafts carry a `rev` that must be sent on edits and apply.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `templates` | `read` |  | List official and community templates. |
| `template` | `read` |  | Get the blueprint of one official template. |
| `draft` | `edit` | llm | Generate a draft with AI as a background job (optionally with `docs` `[{name, text}]`). |
| `job` | `read` |  | Check job progress; when done, a draft is opened. |
| `answer` | `edit` |  | Answer the AI's clarifying questions. |
| `from_template` | `edit` |  | Turn a template into a draft. |
| `author` | `edit` |  | Write a blueprint yourself and turn it into a draft `{room, goal, common, reply_mode, agents[]}`. |
| `get` | `read` |  | Get a draft. |
| `review` | `read` |  | Step-by-step confirmation (group, then each teammate, then finish). |
| `lint` | `read` |  | Run instant mechanical checks on a draft. |
| `check` | `edit` | llm | Run the AI check on a draft (score plus issues). |
| `revise` | `edit` |  | Edit the group fields of a draft `{room, goal, common, reply_mode, lead}`. |
| `patch_agent` | `edit` |  | Edit one teammate in a draft (by name or index). |
| `add_agent` | `edit` |  | Add a teammate to a draft (max 8). |
| `remove_agent` | `edit` |  | Remove a teammate from a draft. |
| `approve_step` | `edit` |  | Mark a review step as confirmed. |
| `discard` | `edit` |  | Discard a draft. |
| `apply` | `edit` | approval | Create the whole team from a draft (needs approval; high-risk tools need spend). |
| `install_template` | `edit` | approval (some args) | Install a template directly (needs approval; paid `u<n>` templates need spend). |

- **`draft`** — `brief`: Brief describing the team to generate (max 20000 chars). (string, max 20000 chars, required); `name`: Team name. - **`lint`** — `draft_id`: Draft ID. (string, required)
- **`check`** — `draft_id`: Draft ID. (string, required)
- **`revise`** — `draft_id`: Draft ID. (string, required); `rev`: Latest draft revision (on `stale_rev`, call `get` again). (integer, required); `set`: Group fields `{room, goal, common, reply_mode, lead}`. (object, required)

## team_skill

**Team 技能.** Teach a teammate a skill. `teach` creates a draft skill from a description, then `edit` and `save` it. You can also try, mark, share, retire, restore or delete skills.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `list` | `read` |  | List a teammate's skills. |
| `teach` | `edit` | llm | Turn a piece of text into a draft skill. |
| `edit` | `edit` |  | Edit a skill's `name`, `when`, `triggers`, `not_for`, `steps` or `writes`. |
| `save` | `edit` |  | Make a draft skill take effect. |
| `keep` | `edit` |  | Keep a skill (do not treat it as stale). |
| `retire` | `edit` |  | Retire a skill (set it aside). |
| `restore` | `edit` |  | Restore a retired skill. |
| `share` | `edit` |  | Share a skill with the whole team. |
| `unshare` | `edit` |  | Stop sharing a skill with the team. |
| `mark` | `edit` |  | Mark a skill as tried (`passed`) or needing a look (`needs_look`). |
| `try` | `edit` | llm | Dry-run how the skill would behave on an example, without using tools. |
| `from_turn` | `edit` | llm | Draft a skill from the previous conversation turn. |
| `flag_wrong` | `edit` |  | Flag that a teammate used the wrong skill. |
| `delete` | `edit` | approval | Delete a skill (needs approval). |

<details><summary>Arguments</summary>

- **`list`** — `agent_id`: Teammate ID. (integer, required)
- **`teach`** — `agent_id`: Teammate ID. (integer, required); `text`: Description of the skill to teach. (string, required)
- **`edit`** — `skill_id`: Skill ID. (integer, required); `set`: Fields to change: `name`, `when`, `triggers`, `not_for`, `steps`, `writes`. (object, required)
- **`save`** — `skill_id`: Skill ID. (integer, required)
- **`keep`** — `skill_id`: Skill ID. (integer, required)
- **`retire`** — `skill_id`: Skill ID. (integer, required)
- **`restore`** — `skill_id`: Skill ID. (integer, required)
- **`share`** — `skill_id`: Skill ID. (integer, required)
- **`unshare`** — `skill_id`: Skill ID. (integer, required)
- **`mark`** — `skill_id`: Skill ID. (integer, required); `as`: Mark as `passed` or `needs_look`. (one of `passed`, `needs_look`, required)
- **`try`** — `skill_id`: Skill ID. (integer, required); `example`: Example situation to dry-run. (string, required)
- **`from_turn`** — `room_id`: Group ID of the conversation. (integer, required); `agent_id`: Teammate ID. (integer, required)
- **`flag_wrong`** — `room_id`: Group ID of the conversation. (integer, required); `name`: Name of the skill used wrongly. (string, required)

## team_deploy

**Team 派工.** Deploy a task to a group, billed per teammate turn; always needs approval first. Also lists deploy runs and cancels runs in progress.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deploy` | `spend` | paid, approval | Deploy work to a group (needs approval). `per_agent` maps teammate id to a task or `{task, mode: hands_on\|research\|review}`; if all have a `mode`, lead planning is skipped. |
| `runs` | `read` |  | List deploy history and runs in progress. |
| `cancel` | `edit` |  | Stop deploy runs in progress. |

<details><summary>Arguments</summary>

- **`deploy`** — `room_id`: Group ID. (integer, required); `brief`: Task brief for the group. (string, required); `agent_ids`: Teammate IDs to deploy to (default: group). (array of integers, optional); `per_agent`: Per-teammate tasks: teammate id -> task, or `{task, mode: hands_on|research|review}`. (object, optional)
- **`runs`** — `room_id`: Group ID. (integer, required)
- **`cancel`** — `room_id`: Group ID. (integer, required)

</details>

## team_evolve

**Team 進化.** Evolve a group's harness: run k trial runs, pick blind, adopt the winner. You can also inspect, validate, hand-edit and roll back the harness, and manage the experience library and evolve settings.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | `read` |  | Evolve overview: runs, harness, settings, experience library. |
| `run` | `read` |  | Details of one evolve run (`full=true` includes the full harness text). |
| `harness` | `read` |  | Get the harness (a given version). |
| `validate` | `read` |  | Validate a harness: merges like `harness_edit` but writes nothing. |
| `start` | `spend` | paid, approval | Start an evolve run, `k` 1-3 (needs approval). |
| `cancel` | `edit` |  | Cancel an evolve run. |
| `harness_edit` | `edit` |  | Hand-edit the harness `{path: text\|null}`: merged with existing, `null` deletes a file, `replace: true` replaces the whole tree. |
| `rollback` | `edit` | approval | Roll back the harness to a version (0 clears it) (needs approval). |
| `pin` | `edit` |  | Pin or unpin an experience entry. |
| `forget` | `edit` | approval | Delete an experience entry (needs approval). |
| `settings` | `edit` | approval (some args) | Change evolve settings; turning on `auto` or `prophet` spends automatically, so it needs spend (needs approval). |

<details><summary>Arguments</summary>

- **`status`** — `room_id`: Group ID. (integer, required)
- **`run`** — `room_id`: Group ID. (integer, required); `run_id`: Evolve run ID. (integer, required); `full`: Include the full harness text. (boolean, optional)
- **`harness`** — `room_id`: Group ID. (integer, required); `version`: Harness version. (integer, optional)
- **`validate`** — `room_id`: Group ID. (integer, required); `tree`: Harness files `{path: text|null}`. (object, required); `replace`: Replace the whole harness instead of merging. (boolean, optional)
- **`start`** — `room_id`: Group ID. (integer, required); `task`: Task to evolve against. (string, optional); `agent_id`: Teammate ID to focus on. (integer, optional); `k`: Number of trial runs (1-3). (integer, optional); `mode`: Run trials `parallel` or `sequential`. (one of `parallel`, `sequential`, optional)
- **`cancel`** — `room_id`: Group ID. (integer, required); `run_id`: Evolve run ID. (integer, required)
- **`harness_edit`** — `room_id`: Group ID. (integer, required); `tree`: Harness files `{path: text|null}`; `null` deletes a file. (object, required); `note`: Note for the edit. (string, optional); `replace`: Replace the whole harness instead of merging. (boolean, optional)
- **`rollback`** — `room_id`: Group ID. (integer, required); `version`: Version to roll back to (0 clears the harness). (integer, required)

## team_confirm

**Team 確認.** After `needs_confirmation`: `show` displays the summary (no charge, token not consumed). Repeat the call with `confirm_token` only after the user approves. With `approval: "user"` (only when the key's owner turned on page approval) the user must approve on the `approve_url` page on AlgoHash; call `wait` until they decide. A yes in chat does not count.

| Action | Scopes | Flags | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `show` | `read` |  | Show the approval summary for a `confirm_token` (includes `approve_url` when `approval` is `"user"`). |
| `wait` | `read` |  | Wait for the user to approve or decline on the AlgoHash approval page (up to 50 s; call again while `open`). |

<details><summary>Arguments</summary>

- **`show`** — `confirm_token`: Token from the `needs_confirmation` result. (string, required); `summary`: Approval summary text to display. (string, optional)
- **`wait`** — `confirm_token`: Token from the `needs_confirmation` result. (string, required); `timeout_sec`: Seconds to wait, 5 to 50. (integer, optional)

</details>
